content.short: Walrus is a decentralized storage and data availability protocol on Sui designed for large-scale Web3 data.
content.description:
Walrus is a pioneering decentralized storage and data availability protocol developed by Mysten Labs, the team behind the Sui blockchain. Specifically engineered to handle large "blobs" of data—such as high-fidelity videos, rich gaming assets, and AI datasets—Walrus achieves unparalleled levels of performance and cost-effectiveness. The network utilizes a novel encoding algorithm called RedStuff to ensure that data remains resilient and highly available even if a significant number of storage nodes go offline.

Acting as a foundational infrastructure layer for the decentralized web, Walrus enables developers to build data-intensive applications that were previously impractical on-chain. The protocol focuses on high throughput and secure data management, providing institutional-grade reliability within a transparent and permissionless framework. Through its commitment to technical innovation and deep integration with the Sui ecosystem, Walrus is empowering the next generation of builders to create scalable decentralized platforms that prioritize data integrity and global accessibility.
